title: heap priority queue
goal: P4.1 Top-k, streaming medians, custom orderings

tasks.do: Reach for a heap when the extreme is needed repeatedly, especially over a stream
Use a min-heap of size k for "k largest", and say why
Write custom order as a comparator, not by pre-transforming the data
Split a stream at its median with two heaps
Quote O(n log k) vs O(n log n) when choosing the heap size
Solve all four exercises inside their target times
Say whether you need the extreme once or repeatedly before choosing heap vs sort
State the heap's size bound and what it costs
Name the rebalancing rule before writing the two-heap code
